chapter: Leaving Hampton and starting his own band
title: Handing in his notice in Cleveland with a detective as witness
summary: In Cleveland Cobb gives Hampton written notice with a detective friend present as witness and plays one show before Johnny Griffin takes over.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
